13.flag_reason: Option D is a defensible second reading: the transcript says 'the older fish led the move — they were over the new ground almost at once', which a listener can reasonably render as 'fish tagged at the old site were being caught over the new one within a single season.' D is never contradicted — it is true of the older cohort — so both C (the age split, the stated finding) and D survive an appeal. D's only weaknesses (tagging site unstated, 'fish' unqualified) are lawyer-level, not listener-level.
